# JuMBO Tribunal

Automatic case files for the 42 claimed Jupiter-mass binary objects (JuMBOs) in the Orion Nebula Cluster, from Pearson & McCaughrean (2023), checked against later JWST spectra.

- Live: https://qusid.github.io/jumbo-tribunal/
- Catalog: Pearson & McCaughrean 2023, arXiv:2310.01231
- Spectra: Luhman 2025, arXiv:2507.03679
- Imaging: JWST GTO 1256 NIRCam, ESASky HiPS

This is not a discovery pipeline. Pearson masses assume a 1 Myr member at 390 pc. A spectrum that says background or stellar wins.

## Run locally

```bash
npm install
npm run ingest
npm run dev
```

`npm run ingest` rebuilds `public/catalog.json` and JWST cutouts from the public Pearson table plus spectroscopic priors in `data/`.
